description: NYSDOT Highway Record Plans: Beginning 1900 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. Details of State Highway Construction projects. Provides locations, construction dates, contract amounts, State Highway numbers, contract numbers, work description, nature of work. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are highways, construction details, roads, right-of-way, engineering drawings. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
